mapper.select: SELECT FROM catalog_channel_price WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND store_id=#{store} AND sku_id=#{sku} AND channel=#{channel} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM catalog_channel_price WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND store_id=#{store} AND sku_id=#{sku} ORDER BY channel
SELECT FROM catalog_channel_price_revision WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND store_id=#{store} AND sku_id=#{sku} AND channel=#{channel} AND version>#{after} ORDER BY version LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO catalog_channel_price(tenant_id,sku_id,store_id,channel,version,unit_price,valid_from,valid_to,active,reason,actor_id,changed_at) VALUES(#{tenant},#{price.skuId},#{price.storeId},#{price.channel},#{price.version},#{price.unitPrice},#{price.validFrom},#{price.validTo},#{price.active},#{price.reason},#{price.actorId},#{price.changedAt}) AS incoming ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE version=incoming.version,unit_price=incoming.unit_price,valid_from=incoming.valid_from,valid_to=incoming.valid_to,active=incoming.active,reason=incoming.reason,actor_id=incoming.actor_id,changed_at=incoming.changed_at
